All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Card
Represents a single UNO card with a color and a rank.
Color
Represents the color of an UNO card.
Command
Represents a single parsed command from the script file.
Command.Type
The type of command.
DeckLoader
Reads a deck file and returns an ordered list of Card objects.
Direction
Represents the current direction of play.
DiscardPile
Represents the discard pile on which players place played cards.
DrawPile
Represents the draw pile (deck) from which players draw cards.
EventLogger
Responsible for printing the structured event log to standard output.
GameEngine
The core UNO game engine.
GameSetup
Responsible for setting up the initial GameState from an ordered list of cards, a player count, and a cards-per-player count.
GameState
Holds the full mutable state of an UNO game: players, draw pile, discard pile, current player, direction, active color, and game-phase flags.
GameState.Phase
Game phases used to validate commands.
Main
Main entry point for the UNO game engine (Phase 1).
Player
Represents a player in the UNO game.
Rank
Represents the rank (type) of an UNO card.
ScriptParser
Reads a script file line by line, returning one Command per call to nextCommand().
